checklistGeneric: Change request is authorized by the named policyholder of record
Effective date is not backdated past the last billed installment
Audit trail entry written with maker and checker user IDs
checklistSpecific: Open the billing account in BillingCenter and confirm the current payment plan (annual / semi-annual / quarterly / monthly EFT) before editing
Set the new payment plan with an effective date on or after the next unbilled installment due date, never mid-installment
Re-run the instalment schedule preview and confirm the sum of remaining instalments equals unbilled written premium to the cent
Confirm any mode-change or instalment fee is added per the state-filed fee schedule for the policy state
Verify the next premium notice regenerates with the new amount and due date before releasing the change

testing.expected: Billing account shows the new payment plan with an effective date and a regenerated instalment schedule whose total equals unbilled written premium
No orphaned instalment rows remain from the superseded payment plan

checklistGeneric: Rule table version is the current approved release
Change is peer-reviewed before promotion
Rule source citation is retained with the configuration
checklistSpecific: Pull the state/line advance-notice matrix (days before due date a bill must be mailed) and confirm each row cites the current statute or bulletin
Configure the notice lead-time parameter per state and line in the billing platform rather than hard-coding a single company-wide value
Run a sample bill for the shortest-lead-time state and confirm the print/mail date is at or before the statutory minimum
Confirm mailing-date stamping is captured on the notice record so proof of mailing can be produced on demand
Flag any state where the configured lead time equals the statutory minimum with no buffer and raise to compliance

testing.expected: Advance-notice lead-time parameter exists for every active state/line combination with a statutory citation
No policy state uses a default lead time shorter than its statutory minimum

checklistGeneric: Assignment matches the payment plan elected on the application
Change is stamped with user ID and timestamp
No manual override without a documented reason code
checklistSpecific: Read the elected payment plan from the policy record and select the matching billing cycle code on the billing account
Set the cycle anchor day so the first due date falls on or after the policy effective date
Confirm the cycle does not push the final instalment beyond the policy expiration date
Verify the assigned cycle produces the expected instalment count (e.g. 12 for monthly EFT on an annual term)

testing.expected: Billing account carries a billing cycle code and anchor day consistent with the policy effective date
No instalment is scheduled with a due date after policy expiration

checklistGeneric: Data is captured only through the tokenised entry channel
Full account or card numbers are never keyed into notes, email or case comments
Consent to debit is captured and dated
checklistSpecific: Capture routing number and account number through the payment-gateway hosted field so the billing record stores only a token and last four digits
Validate the ABA routing number check digit and confirm the account type (checking / savings) before saving
For a card, confirm the payment gateway returns an authorisation on a zero-dollar or $1 verification before the mandate is activated
Verify the account holder name matches the payor of record; if it differs, obtain and file the third-party payor authorisation
Confirm no image or screenshot containing the full account or card number is attached to the billing case

testing.expected: Billing account holds a payment token with last-four masking and a dated debit authorisation record
No full bank account or PAN value is stored in free-text fields or case attachments

checklistGeneric: Group agreement terms are on file before configuration
Remitter contact and remittance instructions are recorded
Configuration is reviewed by a second preparer
checklistSpecific: Create the list-bill / payroll-deduction billing account and link every covered certificate or policy to that single account
Set the group remittance cycle to match the employer payroll frequency (weekly / bi-weekly / semi-monthly / monthly)
Load the initial census and confirm the billed lives count and total premium tie to the group master policy schedule
Configure the tolerance for underpayment/overpayment so short remittances suspend rather than auto-write-off
Send a test list bill to the group administrator and confirm the file layout and member identifiers are usable for their payroll system

testing.expected: Group billing account exists with all covered certificates linked and a remittance cycle matching the employer payroll frequency
No covered certificate remains on individual direct bill after group activation

checklistGeneric: Confirmation is recorded in the case, not only verbally
Both systems are checked, not just the originating one
Any discrepancy is raised before the first notice releases
checklistSpecific: Confirm the policy status in the policy administration system is Bound/In Force before the billing account is activated
Compare the billing account premium against the policy written premium and confirm they agree to the cent
Confirm the policy effective date and billing account start date match
Record the confirmation with the policy contact name and timestamp on the new-business billing case

testing.expected: New-business billing case carries a dated activation confirmation referencing the in-force policy number

checklistGeneric: Delivery preference of record drives the channel, not the default
Print/mail vendor acknowledgement is received and reconciled
Undeliverable returns are routed for address correction

Confirm the print vendor return file count and dollar total match the released notice batch control totals
Verify e-delivery bounce-backs are captured and the affected policies are re-queued to paper within the notice lead time
Confirm portal-only policyholders have a posted statement visible in the self-service portal on the release date
Check that suppressed accounts (lapsed, cancelled, paid-in-full) were excluded from the distribution

testing.expected: Every released notice has a delivery channel and a vendor or portal delivery acknowledgement
No policy appears in more than one delivery channel for the same billing cycle

checklistGeneric: Account is created from the bound policy record, never keyed from scratch
Payor of record is identified before the first notice
Duplicate-account check is run on the insured
checklistSpecific: Create the billing account keyed to the policy number and confirm the account holder name and mailing address match the policy declarations
Set the payment plan, first due date and instalment count from the elected billing mode
Confirm the account currency, billing entity and legal entity code match the writing company on the policy
Run a duplicate search on the insured name and address to confirm no second billing account already exists
Confirm the account balance opens at the full written premium with zero prior transactions

checklistGeneric: Record is generated from live billing data, not a staged copy

testing.expected: First-bill record contains policy number, due date, itemised premium lines and remittance reference

checklistGeneric: Batch runs on the published billing calendar date
Batch control totals are reconciled before release

checklistGeneric: Every field change captures before-value and after-value

checklistGeneric: Both extracts are cut as of the same date and time

checklistGeneric: Written authorisation from the named insured is on file before redirection

checklistGeneric: Report period and cut-off time are stated on the face of the report
Figures reconcile to the source system, not a manual tally

checklistGeneric: Authorisation is retained for the full retention period after the last debit

checklistGeneric: Change request source is verified before the record is edited

checklistGeneric: Comparison uses system-of-record values on both sides

checklistGeneric: Application follows the documented payment hierarchy, not preparer judgement

checklistGeneric: Match is on a system identifier, not a name similarity

checklistGeneric: All inbound channels are captured on the same day, none deferred

checklistGeneric: Payment page is tokenised end to end

checklistGeneric: Escalation follows the documented threshold table, not ad-hoc judgement

checklistGeneric: Draft file is balanced to the billing ledger before transmission

checklistGeneric: Every posting carries a unique transaction reference

checklistGeneric: Payment is validated against contract limits before posting
Allocation follows the owner election of record

checklistGeneric: Reconciliation is per remitter, per billing period

checklistGeneric: Reconciliation is performed daily, not batched to month end

checklistGeneric: Report is issued by the published cut-off time
